name: web-card-fills-while-a-tab-loads-light
description:
A new tab showed the window backdrop through the web card until its page painted. The handed-over url is a blackholed address, so the connection hangs and the page never commits while the frame is captured. The card must read as the light page background, not the tint behind it.

WHY A LAYER AND NOT THE RenderWidgetHostView COLOUR. The first fix set rwhv->SetBackgroundColor(white) alone. The browser test went green - GetBackgroundColor really does return white - and this scenario still measured 101.0/119.1/136.0 over the card, the oceanBlue tint untouched. On Mac that colour paints the NSView's own background layer, and the page reaches this pane through holder()'s ui::Layer instead, so nothing of it is on screen. PaneWebView paints its own LAYER_SOLID_COLOR layer as well, which is the half that shows. Both halves ship, the way Chrome's ContentsWebView does.

WHY THE SIDEBAR IS READ TOO. A card that reads white proves nothing on its own - a window that failed to paint its tint at all would read white everywhere. The sidebar region is the control that says the tint is still there and only the card changed.

THE CORNER GATE. The card's radii live on holder()'s layer. A fill painted on the WebView's own layer covers that layer, so it needs the same radii or the card turns square without any colour changing. The 6x6 patch on the top-left arc is where a square corner would show as flat white.

actions.note: 10.255.255.1 drops the SYN in the VM, so the navigation stays pending for over a minute

assertions.label: the-loading-card-is-white
assertions.desc: MEASURED 2026-09-13: 255.0/255.0/255.0 var 0.0. The same region on the build before the layer fill measured 101.0/119.1/136.0 - the oceanBlue tint straight through the card - which fails min_mean and min_r together.

assertions.label: the-far-corner-of-the-card-is-white-too
assertions.desc: MEASURED 2026-09-13: 255.0/255.0/255.0 var 0.0. A fill sized to the wrong rect would cover the first region and leave this one on the tint.

assertions.label: the-sidebar-keeps-its-tint
assertions.desc: THE CONTROL, MEASURED 2026-09-13: 102.0/120.9/137.0, mean 120.0. A window that painted no tint at all would read white here and make the two card assertions above meaningless.

assertions.label: the-card-corner-is-still-round
assertions.desc: MEASURED 2026-09-13: 163.1/174.7/182.8, mean 173.5, var 3533.1 - the anti-aliased arc, tint outside it and white inside. A fill that missed holder()'s radii squares this corner off and the patch reads a flat 255.
Cmd+Q still quits cleanly with a navigation left pending
